jobs.description: Career Category Engineering Job Description ABOUT AMGEN Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today. ABOUT THE ROLE The Engineering Data Analysis & Reporting Analyst is an individual contributor role responsible for delivering trusted, standardized analytics, reporting, and insights across Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) and Engineering Operations Services (EOS) domains. This role enables data-driven decision-making by designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, KPI frameworks, and analytics solutions that provide actionable insights into operational performance, compliance, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives. Reporting to the Engineering Data analysis and Reporting Lead, this role partners closely with Engineering, EHS, EOS, Master Data Management, Data Engineering, and Technology teams to ensure reporting solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise data and analytics strategies. The role will leverage Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Enterprise Data Lake (EDL), Power BI, and Tableau platforms to integrate data, build reporting solutions, and maintain KPI governance standards. ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES Develop, maintain, and enhance standardized dashboards, scorecards, and reports supporting EHS and EOS governance, operational performance, compliance monitoring, and business decision-making. Design and implement interactive reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, and Microsoft Fabric to provide actionable business insights. Integrate and transform data from Enterprise Data Lake (EDL), Databricks, enterprise applications, and other data sources to create scalable reporting and analytics solutions. Build and maintain datasets, semantic models, and reporting layers that ensure consistent KPI calculations and reporting standards across EHS and EOS. Establish, maintain, and continuously improve the EHS and EOS KPI Registry, including KPI definitions, business rules, calculations, ownership, targets, thresholds, source systems, and reporting governance. Define, document, and maintain leading and lagging indicators that support proactive risk management, operational performance monitoring, and compliance reporting. Support the Data Analysis and Reporting Lead in managing and maintaining SharePoint sites, reporting content, document libraries, permissions, and data resources; requires proficiency in SharePoint administration, information architecture, data organization, access management, and stakeholder support. Ensure analytics and reporting solutions are accurate, traceable, validated, and audit ready. Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to ensure data integrity and reporting reliability. Translate business, operational, compliance, and stakeholder requirements into reporting and analytics solutions. Analyze data to identify trends, performance gaps, risks, opportunities, and emerging signals that support continuous improvement initiatives. Develop executive-level reporting, management scorecards, and ad-hoc analytics to support strategic and operational decision-making. Collaborate with Systems, Master Data Management, Data Engineering, and Technology teams to improve data quality, governance, and reporting capabilities. Support reporting governance processes, KPI standardization, metric alignment, and reporting best practices. Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes, streamline workflows, and improve reporting efficiency through analytics and technology solutions. Create and maintain reporting documentation, data dictionaries, KPI definitions, and process documentation to support sustainable operations and knowledge management. Engage stakeholders across Engineering, EHS, EOS, Operations, Quality, Compliance, and Technology organizations to ensure reporting solutions meet business needs and drive adoption. Interpret data using sound analytical methods and business context to provide meaningful recommendations and actionable insights. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, Business Analytics, or related fields. 7–9 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, data visualization, or data management roles. Hands-on experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI and Tableau. Experience developing KPI frameworks, metric definitions, reporting standards, and governance processes. Experience integrating and analyzing data from multiple enterprise systems and data sources. Demonstrated experience translating business requirements into reporting and analytics solutions. Experience performing data validation, quality assurance, and reporting controls within a regulated environment. Ability to work on site in Hyderabad and collaborate with stakeholders across global time zones when required. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS Advanced expertise with Power BI, Tableau, Microsoft Fabric, and Databricks analytics environments. Experience building and maintaining KPI registries, metric catalogs, data dictionaries, and reporting governance frameworks. Strong understanding of leading and lagging indicators, operational performance metrics, and risk-based reporting methodologies. Experience supporting EHS, Engineering, Facilities, Manufacturing, Operations, or Quality business functions. Experience working with EHS platforms such as Cority, Sphera, Enablon, or similar systems. Knowledge of enterprise data governance, master data management, and data quality best practices. Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills with the ability to influence without direct authority. Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced global environment. Experience supporting continuous improvement, automation, and digital transformation initiatives. Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics, predictive reporting, and advanced visualization techniques. Experience working across regions and time zones with global stakeholder teams. PROFESSIONAL CERTIFICATIONS: Certifications in Microsoft Power BI , Tableau (Certified Professional) , or Databricks (Data Analyst/Data Engineer) are advantageous and considered a plus. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. Work Hours Work hours and shift requirements may vary based on business needs. Flexibility to work across different shifts may be required. jobs.title: Systems and Master Data Management Specialist
jobs.description: Career Category Engineering Job Description ABOUT AMGEN Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today. ABOUT THE ROLE The Systems and Master Data Management Manager is responsible for leading a team that enables Engineering, Facilities, EHS, and EOS operations through the governance, administration, and continuous improvement of business-critical systems, master data, and supporting business processes. The team serves as the bridge between Business and Technology, ensuring systems and data are reliable, compliant, scalable, and aligned with operational and enterprise objectives. This role is responsible for maintaining system integrity, enabling business process standardization, governing master data, supporting technology integrations, and ensuring users can effectively leverage systems to drive operational performance, compliance, and business outcomes. This role owns governance and operational oversight for key enterprise applications including SAP S/4HANA, SAP MDG, Collibra, CMMS/EAM platforms, Cority, Sphera, Enablon, and other Engineering, Facilities, and EHS systems. The manager is accountable for ensuring systems remain operational, secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise architecture, governance standards, and FAIR data principles. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Systems and Master Data Management, this role partners closely with Technology, Data Analytics, Operations, Quality, Compliance, Engineering, Facilities, and EHS stakeholders to deliver integrated system and data capabilities that support operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and long-term digital transformation strategies. ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES Builds and leads a high-performing team responsible for enterprise systems administration, master data management, governance, and operational support across Engineering, Facilities, EHS, and EOS domains. Owns governance, operational health, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of business-critical applications including SAP S/4HANA, SAP MDG, Collibra, CMMS/EAM platforms, Cority, Sphera, Enablon, and related enterprise systems. Establishes and governs master data standards, ownership, stewardship models, lifecycle processes, and data quality controls to ensure trusted, consistent, and compliant business data. Leads SAP S/4HANA and enterprise transformation initiatives by ensuring data readiness, migration governance, master data quality, system integration readiness, and sustainable operating processes. Oversees system administration activities including access management, security controls, incident management, change management, release support, compliance monitoring, and operational support processes. Ensures data extracted from enterprise systems is complete, accurate, traceable, reconciled, and free from deficiencies before being consumed by downstream business functions, analytics platforms, and reporting solutions. Establishes governance capabilities utilizing Collibra to manage business glossaries, metadata, data lineage, stewardship workflows, ownership models, policies, controls, and data quality monitoring processes. Partners with Technology, Data Engineering, Operations, Quality, Compliance, Engineering, Facilities, and EHS stakeholders to align systems, master data, integrations, and governance capabilities with enterprise priorities. Supports enterprise integrations, FAIR data principles, data traceability, and sustainable business processes that enable operational effectiveness and informed decision-making. Drives continuous improvement initiatives focused on system reliability, governance maturity, data quality, operational efficiency, user experience, and business process standardization. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Business Administration, or a related field. 9 - 13 years of experience in Master Data Management, Systems Management, Enterprise Applications, Data Governance, Data Quality, or related disciplines. Hands-on experience supporting SAP S/4HANA environments, SAP Master Data Governance (MDG), and enterprise system integrations. Experience supporting CMMS/EAM platforms, Engineering systems, Asset Management systems, and enterprise operational applications. Experience managing master data standards, governance processes, data quality initiatives, and stewardship programs. Experience performing data extraction, ETL development, data transformation, validation, reconciliation, and lineage management activities. Strong understanding of data governance principles, metadata management, data quality controls, and master data lifecycle management. Experience delivering governed, traceable, and high-quality enterprise data assets for downstream consumption by reporting, analytics, integration, and operational systems. Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into scalable systems and data solutions. Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP MDG, Collibra, SAP EAM/PM, CMMS, Maximo, or similar enterprise Engineering and Asset Management platforms. Experience supporting S/4HANA migration programs, master data conversion, data cleansing, and data readiness initiatives. Strong knowledge of Master Data Management (MDM), data governance, data quality, stewardship, and lifecycle management practices. Experience with EHS systems such as Cority, Sphera, Enablon, INCA, or similar platforms. Understanding of enterprise integrations, ETL processes, data lineage, metadata management, and traceability requirements. Experience establishing governance controls, reconciliation processes, and audit-ready data management practices. Knowledge of Clean Core principles, enterprise architecture standards, and regulated system governance. Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to influence without direct authority. Experience partnering with Technology, Operations, Quality, Compliance, Engineering, EHS, and Business teams in global environments. Demonstrated ability to drive continuous improvement, support change management initiatives, and ensure delivery of high-quality, governed, and defect-free data. PROFESSIONAL CERTIFICATIONS: Professional certifications in SAP S/4HANA , SAP MDG , SAP EAM/PM , CDMP , or related disciplines such as Data Governance, Data Quality, Asset Management, Information Management, and Enterprise Systems Administration are advantageous and considered a plus. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. Work Hours Work hours and shift requirements may vary based on business needs. Flexibility to work across different shifts may be required. .

cold_email.subject: Interest in Systems and Master Data Management Specialist — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Systems and Master Data Management Specialist opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
